title: App Rate
body: I think it is a really cool app, it helps a ton, the only thing that kills the vibe it’s the fact that u gotta pay if u want to have more stuff. For example to add more habits, u can only have 3 for free, I think we could have more. But other than that its amazing!!
author: Nádia05

title: Simple, clean, awesome
body:
After trying many habit tracking apps, this one stood out as the best, for its simplicity, ease of use and focus on the essential. 
It is very well crafted and despite being simple it has some very nice details and features, such as the interactive widgets, customization options, animations, and more. Furthermore, it has the ability to define when a day ends, allowing to mark a habit done past midnight, which I really like.
Recommended! Keep it up!
author: p4checo
